title: Validation Facet -- validation.yaml
description: SDD-R011 §10, SDD-R001 §13. Reusable engineering validation rules the owning object contributes to the Engineering Reference Library, consumed by Diagram Studio / Engineering Engine validation, never duplicated there (SDD-R001 §13). As of WORK_PACKAGE_002 (REFERENCE-TASK-000014): a rule is the same structured Constraint shape (subject/operator/operand) constraint.schema.json defines, plus a rule_id and severity -- fields are inlined here rather than composed via $ref/allOf, since `additionalProperties: false` on a $ref'd subschema rejects sibling fields added by the same allOf, a well-known JSON Schema composition pitfall. SDD-R011 §10: "Human-readable validation text shall not be authoritative," so the free-text `expression` string WORK_PACKAGE_001 used is gone; `description` remains only as non-authoritative documentation alongside the structured fields.

subject.description: The property_id (or "self") this rule constrains -- see constraint.schema.json.

description.description: Non-authoritative documentation of the rule above (SDD-R011 §10).
